Services / Carbide Recycling Carbide Recycling Services Carbide Recycling Services Recycle your scrap carbide inserts, end mills and more Get a Quote Carbide Scrap Recycling At Kennametal, sustainability is just as much a part of our DNA as our innovative, industry-leading tools are. We are committed to responsible environmental practices and ensuring that our customers also have access to contribute to a greener manufacturing world. With nearly 90 years of experience, a reputation as a world-class tungsten smelter and for offering consistent, competitive value for scrap carbide, we’re your trusted partner for taking your shop’s sustainability to the next level. How to Recycle Your Scrap Carbide with Kennametal Get Your Price Connect with our team about your scrap tungsten carbide to get a market-competitive quote. Ship Your Scrap Request a shipping container , package up your scrap and ship via your preferred carrier. Get Paid After we receive and weigh your scrap tungsten carbide, you get paid. Tungsten Carbide Scrap We Buy The Carbide Recycling Program accepts several kinds of tungsten carbide scrap, including: Metal cutting inserts Drills End Mills Wear components If you don’t see your carbide material listed here or have soft scrap, reach out to us for assistance and pricing. FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions What is tungsten carbide? Tungsten carbide is a compound made of tungsten and carbon with a cobalt/nickel binder. Because of its reputation for extreme hardness and durability, tungsten carbide is used in a wide variety of applications such as metal cutting, earth cutting and wear solutions. How much is used tungsten carbide worth? The value of tungsten carbide fluctuates based on a multitude of factors. Our team continuously monitors the market to ensure we offer competitive pricing. How do I ship my used materials for recycling? All customers can ship used tungsten carbide to us in their own sturdy containers, but we also provide shipping containers. Customers in the United States and Canada can request shipping containers when filling out the order form . Customers in Europe can request shipping containers (25 kg. capacity each) using Order Number 7434059 directly through Kennametal Customer Service or a local sales representative. For shipping container needs over 300 kg. or additional assistance, contact k-corp-emea.toncarbide@kennametal.com . How much are your shipping containers? We supply varying sizes of shipping containers to our customers at no additional cost. How do you ensure the carbide you purchase is sourced responsibly? We’re a proud member of the Responsible Minerals Initiative, which has recognized our smelters as Responsible Minerals Assurance Process conformant. Learn what else we do to ensure responsible sourcing here . Where are carbide recycling services offered? Kennametal’s Carbide Recycling Program is currently available in the United States, Canada and for countries in the European Union, with new regional expansions coming soon. Is there a minimum or maximum amount to meet for carbide recycling services? For customers in the United States and Canada, there's no weight minimum. We can accommodate your largest carbide recycling needs. Reach out to us directly for recycling services above 3,000 pounds. For customers in Europe, there is a weight minimum of 50 kg. and we can accommodate your largest carbide recycling needs. Reach out to us directly for recycling services above 500 kg. What happens to my used tungsten carbide? Your used tungsten carbide is recycled through Zinc Reclaim at our Huntsville, Alabama smelting facility. Once broken down, the material is processed into powder which goes on to create the high-performance, next level tools we’re known for. Have Questions for Us? Our skilled staff is ready to help.
